title: Logos 8 opening: not like the will but like the Father
english: Eighth discourse. Against those who say the Son is like not the Father but the Father’s will.
Likeness to a will-as-instrument is rejected; the Son is like the Father himself.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
